limits: Serialized intervals describe the measured rotating repetitions of these allocations only. Any preregistered incomplete baseline prefix retains two complete measured rotations after warmup; its raw complete flag and extra completed phases remain explicit. This limits precision. Asynchronous modes use continuous windows, normal task rewards and EOS with declared warmup/measured counts; Phase boundaries exclude initial warmup and final context teardown, retain finite prefetch, and can bias short windows. One allocation per implementation, ordered modes, changing weights, response variation, caches and shared hardware limit causal claims. Only exclusive StepWallTime fields partition the cycle; nested timers and process profiles overlap. Memory device peaks are sampled every 0.1 seconds; allocator caches persist and host peaks are cumulative. No learning-gain claim.
